value: Small tower defense game made for the SizeCon game jam 2026

Space queen Velkira has arrived, and demands the puny humans' size as a royal tithe, and she'll get it one way or another.
Using her expansion beams she intends to harvest this world's size resonance to grow herself.

Place turrets which expand incoming enemy units until they become incapacitated. Send your ship to collect expanded enemies to grow the queen and collect resonance points to expand her body parts. Intervene with special abilities on cooldown if necessary.
